items.title: One Promise, Three Ranges: How TVFM Serves Every Kind of Salon
items.excerpt: No two salons are alike. See how the LUXE, Essentials and Ayurkunj ranges cover every kind of salon, from boutique studios to busy neighbourhood salons.
items.contentHtml:
No two salons are alike. A boutique studio with a luxury clientele has different needs from a busy neighbourhood salon, and both differ from a salon that specialises in natural, holistic care. TVFM Synergy Group built its professional range around this fact, guided by one philosophy: True Value For Money.

LUXE is our premium range, made for high-end salon experiences. Products like the Cleansing Milk, Shaving Gel and D-Tan Mask are designed for luxury-level performance and a refined client experience.

Essentials is our affordable professional range. It delivers dependable quality for everyday salon needs, from salon-size shampoo and conditioner canisters to brightening D-Tan packs.

Ayurkunj is our herbal range, enriched with Ayurvedic ingredients for natural care and holistic beauty. Its hair oils pair traditional herbs with a modern precision-nozzle bottle.

Across all three, we focus on performance, consistency and professional-grade quality. Every product is made to help salons deliver better service with dependable results.

TVFM is also building a wider ecosystem for the industry. It spans salon POS and management software and beauty products through our GLAM division. The aim is to simplify and strengthen salon businesses through integrated professional solutions.

Whatever your segment, you can stock with confidence knowing every TVFM product follows the same promise.

items.title: Gentle Luxury for the Treatment Room: Inside the LUXE Range
items.excerpt: What the LUXE Cleansing Milk, Shaving Gel and D-Tan Mask do in the treatment room, and why they suit a premium salon menu.
items.contentHtml:
When clients book a facial or grooming service, the products you choose shape the whole experience. The LUXE range is made for professionals who want premium performance without compromising on skin comfort.

Cleansing Milk (1000 ml): This silky, lightweight cleanser combines rice water, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. Rice water brightens and smooths, niacinamide evens skin tone and helps control excess oil, and hyaluronic acid boosts hydration. It removes dirt, impurities and light makeup without stripping the skin's natural balance, and it suits all skin types, including sensitive and dry skin.

Shaving Gel (900 ml): A transparent, non-foaming gel made for precision beard shaping and detailing. Aloe vera soothes, cucumber extract cools and glycerine keeps skin hydrated. It supports smooth razor glide and helps reduce irritation and razor burn.

D-Tan Mask (500 g): A salon-grade, herbal de-tan and brightening treatment. It blends clove, eucalyptus, camphor, alpha arbutin, glutathione and Centella asiatica to help reduce tan and pigmentation and to leave skin refreshed and glowing.

All three are free from parabens, silicones and sulphates.

The range also makes business sense. Thicker consistencies mean less product per service, so you can serve more clients with less expense. Pump bottles and jars keep dispensing hygienic and convenient.

items.title: Tan Removal in the Salon: Choosing Between LUXE D-Tan Mask and Essentials D-Tan Pack
items.excerpt: LUXE D-Tan Mask or Essentials D-Tan Pack? How to choose the right tan removal treatment for your salon and your clients.
items.contentHtml:
Tan removal is one of the most requested services in Indian salons, especially after sunny seasons, festivals and wedding events. TVFM offers two professional options so you can match the treatment to your salon and your clients.

LUXE D-Tan Mask (500 g) is the premium choice. Its formula features glutathione and alpha arbutin for brightening, with clove, eucalyptus and camphor to purify and detoxify. Centella asiatica helps soothe and improve skin elasticity.

Essentials D-Tan Pack (500 g and 200 g) is the value-focused choice. It combines kojic acid and alpha arbutin with clove, geranium and peppermint oils to reduce tanning and pigmentation. The two pack sizes suit both high-volume salons and smaller setups.

Both products are applied the same way: an even layer on cleansed skin, left on for 10 to 15 minutes, then wiped off or rinsed thoroughly. Both are suitable for all skin types and free from parabens, silicones and sulphates.

A practical tip: The LUXE D-Tan Mask contains clove oil, so mild tingling or slight burning may occur and is normal. Let clients know before you begin, and wash off immediately if irritation becomes severe.

You can offer the Essentials pack as your standard de-tan service and the LUXE mask as a premium upgrade. That gives clients a clear choice and your salon a stronger service menu.

items.title: Building a Complete Hair Care Menu with Essentials and Ayurkunj
items.excerpt: Start at the wash basin with Essentials, then add scalp rituals with Ayurkunj herbal oils for a full hair care menu.
items.contentHtml:
Hair services bring clients back again and again. A strong menu starts with the right basics, then adds treatments that clients can feel.

Start at the wash basin with Essentials. The Essentials Shampoo with biotin, keratin and saw palmetto cleanses gently while maintaining natural moisture balance, and it supports scalp health. It suits all hair types, especially weak, thinning or damaged hair. The Essentials Conditioner with sandalwood, Ceramide NP and shea butter nourishes dry, damaged hair, helps control frizz and leaves a calming sandalwood fragrance. Both come in 5-litre salon canisters, ideal for bulk use and consistent performance, and both are free from parabens and silicones and cruelty-free.

Add scalp rituals with Ayurkunj. Two herbal oils make easy add-on services:

Coco Ayur Herbal Coconut Hair Oil pairs 5% Brahmi and 5% Jatamansi with a coconut oil base. It is lightweight and non-sticky, and it supports scalp health and hair strength.

Ayur Cool Herbal Cooling Oil is infused with 11 classical Ayurvedic herbs in a sesame oil base. It gives a mild, natural cooling effect that helps soothe heat-related scalp discomfort.

Both oils come in 100, 200 and 500 ml sizes with a precision nozzle for mess-free application directly on the scalp. For a head-massage service, massage gently in circular motions, then leave the oil on for at least 30 minutes before washing off with a mild shampoo.

Together, these two products let you offer a full journey: cleanse, condition and care for the scalp.
